title: Prevalence of Home Rental Scams Using Online Platforms as Conduit
what_it_is: Prevalence of Home Rental Scams Using Online Platforms as Conduit

sections.label: Protection for home owners
sections.summary: Home owners not involved in scams will not be penalised, and Police work with platforms and CEA on advisories.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Member asked about safeguards to protect the real home owners, whose homes have been used in such scams, from liabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Such home owners will not be penalised unless they are involved in perpetrating the scams.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police have been working with online platforms to remove suspicious accounts and advertisements, as well as with the Council for Estate Agencies, or CEA, to include advisories on rental scams on CEA's social media channels.

sections.label: Online platform scam safeguards
sections.summary: Home owners not perpetrating scams are not penalised; MHA launched marketplace safety ratings and urges use of property rental platforms.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As I have mentioned in my main reply, as long as the home owner is not involved in perpetuating the scam, the home owner will not be penalised.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the point about working with the social media platforms, indeed, we have been actively following up with online platforms to work with them to take down fake listings.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In May 2022, the Ministry of Home Affairs had launched the e-commerce marketplace transactions safety ratings, which rates major e-commerce marketplaces on the extent to which they have adopted the identified safety measures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This would include user verification, user authentication, secured payment options, so on and so forth.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In the particular case of property rental scams, we will urge the public to go to formal online platforms whose main business is in property rentals such as Property Guru and other marketplaces, and not to go to other online platforms, such as Facebook or Carousell, whose not main business is not in the property rental space.

sections.label: CEA phone number search
sections.summary: If a CEA phone number search gives no property agent name or no results, the agent and listing are fake.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: If the phone number that you put into this search function under CEA does not give you the property agent's name or leads to no search results, then it means that this so-called property agent is a fake and that you are looking at a fake listing.
